about.title: About SA Consulting
about.lead: SA Consulting supports companies, business leaders, entrepreneurs and project owners with financial structuring, compliance, performance and growth.
body: Our role is to bring a structured perspective to your business, secure your obligations and help you make well-informed decisions.
Every engagement starts from your actual situation: your business, your constraints and your priorities. Our recommendations are practical and aligned with your objectives.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.metaDescription: Privacy policy for saconsulting.biz — how data submitted through the contact form is handled.
privacyPage.intro: SA Consulting attaches great importance to the confidentiality of the information entrusted to it. This page explains what data this website collects and how it is used.

sections.p: Through the contact form: full name, company (optional), email address, phone number (optional), service required and message content. No other personal data is intentionally collected by this website.
This data is used solely to respond to your request and, where relevant, to follow up on the relationship. It is never sold or transferred to third parties for marketing purposes.
Form messages are delivered to {email} through the Web3Forms form delivery service. WhatsApp links open the WhatsApp application, which is subject to its own terms.
This website does not use advertising cookies or audience measurement tools. Only your language preference (FR, EN or AR) is saved in your browser's local storage so that your choice is remembered.
In accordance with Tunisian Organic Law No. 2004-63 of 27 July 2004 on the protection of personal data, you may request access to, correction of or deletion of your data by writing to {email}.
